sources.title: All-Pedal Alcmene Overdrive - The Mother Of Centaur Slayers | Effects Database
sources.h1: All-Pedal Alcmene Overdrive - The Mother Of Centaur Slayers
sources.excerpt: All-Pedal describes Alcmene as a mini overdrive with Klon-style features, including Germanium clipping diodes, an active Treble control, charge pump, buffered bypass, MOSFET power protection, and a 9V/20mA power requirement. The page specifies NOS 1N34A Germanium clipping diodes.

next_action: Use the exact-model evidence for the canonical record. Preserve the explicit 1N34A diode and charge-pump details, but do not infer other component types or circuit topology.
